reason: The frozen protocol requires continuous and discrete endpoints but did not designate which endpoint pair defines stochastic deficit, the primary H2 explorer, censored-cell handling, or the exact decision-status mapping for H4.

endpoint_bookkeeping.continuous_affine: Compute F by exact integration of the piecewise-linear lambda_p grid, then lambda_lower=lambda_p*F/F and lambda_upper=lambda_p*F/(1+(1-c)*(F-1)) for rho=1.
endpoint_bookkeeping.crabs_discrete: Construct constant-turnover zero and constant-turnover c paths with the registered equal-grid CRABS joint recurrence.
endpoint_bookkeeping.sampling_deficit_reference: Use CRABS-discrete endpoints for H2 and H3, isolating finite exploration from grid discretisation.
endpoint_bookkeeping.decision_certificate_reference: Use continuous affine endpoints for H4 and report the corresponding discrete-endpoint status separately; no method claim may attribute their difference to sampling.

decision_ages: For each registered domain fraction, use the nearest time-grid knot with half-up index rounding; the four indices must be distinct.

normalized_deficit.cell_value: maximum of lower and upper deficits across the four registered decision ages
normalized_deficit.nonzero_width: identified_width greater than 1e-12 times max(1, abs(discrete_lower), abs(discrete_upper))
normalized_deficit.largest_attained_prefix: The largest registered prefix not exceeding accepted samples. If no prefix is attained, the cell is censored and counted as deficit_above_threshold=true in the primary H2 denominator.

H2_primary.eligible_cells: All 300 registered cap_matched cells with explorer=crabs_rejection and nonzero width at at least one decision age.
H2_primary.success_event: normalized_deficit at the largest attained prefix is greater than 0.05, or the cell is censored below the first prefix.
H2_primary.decision: Support H2 when success_event is true in at least 20% of eligible cells.
H2_primary.secondary_reporting: Report cap_aware_uniform with the same metric, and native HSMRF/GMRF practicality separately; neither changes the primary decision.

H3_primary.decision: Support H3 only when both constructed discrete endpoints have normalized deficit at most 1e-10 and recurrence residual passes in every eligible cell.

H4_primary.eligible_cells: The same 300 crabs_rejection cells used for H2, using their largest attained prefix; below-first-prefix cells remain censored and contribute no claimed finite-cloud status.
H4_primary.queries: At each of four decision ages and each of four registered signal-median threshold multipliers, create one query.
H4_primary.finite_cloud_status: BELOW if cloud_max<threshold, ABOVE if cloud_min>threshold, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
H4_primary.certificate_status: BELOW if continuous_affine_upper<threshold, ABOVE if continuous_affine_lower>threshold, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
H4_primary.changed: The finite-cloud and certificate status labels differ.
H4_primary.false_certificate: A certificate is false if its BELOW or ABOVE label is contradicted by either analytic affine endpoint; by construction this check must be zero, and any nonzero count fails H4.
H4_primary.decision: Support H4 when at least 20% of evaluable queries change and false_certificate_count is zero. Report censored cells and the discrete-status sensitivity separately.

interval_estimates: For replicate-level proportions report two-sided 95% Wilson intervals without continuity correction; these are descriptive and no significance test is primary.
interpretation_boundary: This amendment is prospective for H2-H4 only. It does not reopen H1, alter H5, or authorize publication.
